medicalSupplement.qualifyingEarningsFormula: max(0, lines10100 + line10400 excluding wage-loss replacement plan amounts - lines20700 - line21200 - line22900 - line23100) + positive net self-employment income from lines13500,13700,13900,14100,14300 excluding losses
medicalSupplement.adjustedFamilyNetIncomeFormula: Worksheet line 6: taxpayer and spouse/common-law partner line23600-equivalent amounts plus UCCB repayment line21300 and RDSP income repayment included on line23200, less UCCB income line11700 and RDSP income line12500, with worksheet separation/death exclusions.

eligibility.minimumAgeOrHousehold: At year end, 19 or older, or resided with a spouse/common-law partner or child.
disqualifiers: full-time student at a designated educational institution for more than 13 weeks unless an eligible dependant existed at year end
confined to prison or similar institution for at least 90 days
exempt from Canadian income tax for a listed diplomatic/official circumstance

basic.formula: max(0, min(max(0, familyWorkingIncome - 3000.00) * 0.27, applicableMaximum) - (max(0, adjustedFamilyNetIncome - applicableReductionThreshold) * 0.15))

disabilitySupplement.formula: max(0, min(max(0, taxpayerWorkingIncome - 1150.00) * 0.27, 843.00) - (max(0, adjustedFamilyNetIncome - applicableDisabilityReductionThreshold) * applicableDisabilityReductionRate))

lineMappings.line42: line40 + line41, where line41 is line28 if Step 2 completed, else 0; enter on return line 45300
lineMappings.line43To49: Advanced CWB: compare line43 with RC210 boxes 10/11 through line49; enter line49 on return line 41500
